summary.content:
Today's selection covers 85 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 61 on Artificial Intelligence and 11 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Terra is safer overall, but shows more destructive-action flags in tests
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: External Teams Chats Anchor 15-Minute Malware Delivery
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, Dark Reading, The Verge, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 51 articles published in the last 24 hours
